bio: Treat yourself to a delightful Afternoon Tea experience at Denham Grove. This picturesque countryside setting provides perfectly peaceful surroundings to indulge in the great British tradition.  Afternoon Tea is served in either the cosy lounge, covered terrace or stylish outdoor pods with 360° views of their 42 acres of beautiful parkland.  Their quintessential Afternoon Tea menu features a range of stunning sandwiches, scones with clotted cream and jam, as well as a sweet plate that includes tantalising delights such as a vanilla slice and a chocolate and orange cheesecake. There is also a sumptuous vegetarian or vegan menu available. Guests feeling in a decadent mood can upgrade to include a glass of Prosecco.  Please mention any allergens or dietary requirements as you process your booking.  Denham Grove is nestled within 42 acres of beautiful parkland in the heart of Buckinghamshire. This venue is located within easy access of the region's major roads and is just 14 miles from Wembley Stadium.
